question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'which'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a pronoun to refer to the phrase '*a man's life'*.
 
• The part following the given blank describes a dependent clause. 
 
• In such a case, we need to use a **relative pronoun **to introduce the dependent clause. 
 
• Both **who **and **which **are relative pronouns. 
 
 
• **Who **is normally used to refer to human beings, either male or female. 
 
• **Which **is used to refer to things or groups. 
 
 
 
• From the above, we can conclude which is the most appropriate option to fill in** blank number 2.**
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer. 

Correct passage__ - *Novelists when they write novels tend to take an almost god-like attitude (1) __towards__ their subject, pretending to have a total comprehension of the story, a man's life, (2) __which__ they can therefore recount as God Himself might, nothing standing between them and the naked truth, the entire story meaningful in (3) __every__ detail. I am as little able to do this as the novelist is, even though my story is more important to me than any novelist's is to him – for this is my story; it is the story of a man, not of an invented or possible, or idealized or otherwise (4) __absent__ figure, but of a unique (5) __being__ of flesh and blood. *
